category_title: Students who disengage and exhibit behavioral issues when curriculum lacks challenge and teacher communication is perceived as indirect
scenario_title: Reviewing previously learned, unchallenging material for test prep
minimal_context: The tutor and student are reviewing previously learned math concepts during the first 30 minutes of class to prepare for the MSA standardized test.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our MSA test prep. For the next thirty minutes, we are going to review the math concepts you were taught in your previous math courses.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are we doing this? You just go over the same old stuff. The way you teach is so boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to review these concepts for the standardized test. Please look at the first problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's not interesting. You're just playing with words. You don't put any style or pizzazz into it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just focus and try to get through this review worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Man, I know this! It's easy! I don't want to listen to her. I just don't feel challenged in here, so I don't care.
